notes: family: ambition-majority-running-track. Ends after chapter scoring at 33/30/27 Power for 2/3/4 players, or chapter 5. Final holdings cannot reconstruct earlier chapters. Schema gap: dynamic ambition-marker awards, first-place ties receiving second award, second-place ties receiving zero, and a two-player neutral comparator cannot all be represented by one rankAward; enter the correctly resolved track. Only declared ambitions score; zero holdings cannot place. City bonus applies once per untied ambition win. Base game only; campaign and Leaders/Lore modifiers excluded.
